name: Sigil
author: Erin Carter
description: Branded runes on black iron: two or three angular, hash-generated sigils sit scattered across a near-black field, each at a different stage of cooling. A fresh brand glows near-white, then heat drains down the palette — rose to violet to ember — with thick stroke junctions holding their heat longest, until only a charred trace remains.

params.label: Strike rate
params.effect: How often a new rune is branded somewhere on the field — min leaves long stretches of slowly dimming embers, max keeps fresh near-white figures appearing every few seconds.

params.label: Cool period
params.effect: Seconds a fresh brand takes to cool from near-white through ember to charred trace — short cycles read as flashes, long ones as patient metalwork.

params.label: Rune size
params.effect: Characteristic height of each branded figure in CSS pixels, from a scatter of small marks to one or two frame-dominating staves.
